description: A woman looks out a train window during heavy rain, side-profile medium shot.

spec.action: She stands or sits still, looking out through the rain-streaked window.
spec.camera_angle: profile, eye level, medium shot, 50mm lens, subject placed on the left third of the frame facing right
spec.lighting: Soft overcast daylight filtered through the rain-soaked window from camera-right, low-contrast cool gray-blue light with faint reflected highlights on her cheek and hair; no visible practicals.
spec.style: Digital capture with fine grain, cool muted color grade, naturalistic contrast, restrained realism
